name: MCNP ENDF/B-VI Iron Benchmark
description: Assesses MCNP simulation accuracy using ENDF/B-VI nuclear data against experimental iron benchmark measurements.
evaluation_method: error metrics (relative error, bias, RMSE, chi-squared) vs. experimental measurements
reputation: A classical, domain-specific validation benchmark well known in the reactor physics/neutronics community for verifying transport codes like MCNP against experimental iron measurements.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; small set of experimental configurations; results are sensitive to the nuclear data library version (ENDF/B-VI is outdated) and to modeling assumptions; primarily used for physics code validation rather than machine-learning evaluation.
